verdicts.file: S M Odigitria al Tritone - l'Odigitria all'altare P1080563.JPG
verdicts.note: Altar with gilded sunburst icon of the Virgin and Latin inscription 'ALTARE QVOTIDIANO PRIVILEGIO PERPETVO'; nun reading.

verdicts.file: San Fantin (Venice) miraculous icon of the Virgin.jpg
verdicts.note: Icon in a marble shrine bearing the Latin inscription 'CORPUS S. MARCELLINAE' - a relic monument of another church.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Fassade.jpg
verdicts.note: White-brick church facade with twin bell towers and red-tiled cupolas on a Mediterranean hillside village.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Langhaus West.jpg
verdicts.note: Church nave with rows of pews, Murano glass chandeliers and a painted vault; interior only.

verdicts.file: Santa Cecilia (Rome) - Ceiling alt.jpg
verdicts.note: Baroque ceiling fresco with angels, God the Father and a painted pipe organ; painting only, no site context.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Nördliches Querschiff.jpg
verdicts.note: Transept wall covered with Byzantine-style frescoes and saint medallions, glass chandelier and wooden pews.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Kuppel 1.jpg
verdicts.note: Cupola interior with frescoes of saints and angels on a blue ground, seen above a glass chandelier.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Gewölbe.jpg
verdicts.note: Vault fresco panels with medallion portraits of church fathers and Greek/Cyrillic inscriptions.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Ikonostase 2.jpg
verdicts.note: Sanctuary behind an iconostasis with hanging silver lamps and a red patterned carpet.

verdicts.file: Galata Kirche Panagia Odigitria Innen Südliches Querschiff.jpg
verdicts.note: Cross-transept wall with a fresco cycle, a round window and rows of pews; interior only.

verdicts.file: Roma, chiesa di Santa Maria Odigitria - Organo a canne.jpg
verdicts.note: Pipe organ with a carved wooden case, keyboards and open sheet music - an instrument, not the site.

verdicts.file: S M Odigitria al Tritone - interno P1080560.JPG
verdicts.note: Side chapel with a gilded sunburst icon of the Virgin; nuns kneeling in the pews, Latin inscription over the altar.

verdicts.file: Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 23 12 2025 07.jpg
verdicts.note: Plaster statue of the Madonna and Child on a side altar with a rack of votive candles.

verdicts.file: Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 23 12 2025 05.jpg
verdicts.note: Framed oil painting of the Madonna and Child with the Italian caption 'Madonna con il bambino' on the gilt frame.

verdicts.file: Processione dell'Epifania Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 06 01 2024 11.jpg
verdicts.note: Two robed men seen from behind walking on a road beside parked cars and a donkey: modern street scene.

verdicts.file: Platanias, monastero di Gonia Odigitria 01.jpg
verdicts.note: Monastery complex with domes and a bell tower seen across a hillside village; nothing in the picture names Odigitria.

verdicts.file: Saint Mary Odigitria Icon in Dolno Drenoveni Kato Kranionas 19th Century.jpg
verdicts.note: Isolated icon of the Virgin Hodegetria with the Greek letters ΜΡ ΘΥ on a plain grey background; object photo, no site.

verdicts.file: Processione dell'Epifania Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 06 01 2024 07.jpg
verdicts.note: Procession: hooded figures walking under a parasol along a village street with cars and street lights.

verdicts.file: Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 06 01 2018 07.jpg
verdicts.note: Worn fresco detail of the Madonna and Child with putti; painting only, no site context.

verdicts.file: Processione dell'Epifania Santa Maria Odigitria (Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto) 06 01 2024 08.jpg
verdicts.note: Boy carrying a star lantern in front of a church wall with an Italian sign reading 'chiesa S. Maria Odigitria'.

note: The site is only named 'Odigitria', country Greece. No picture carries a visible identifier that ties it to that Greek site, so I judged every candidate on what is visible only.
